title: HALO rebrand deny-list
description: Path globs, manifest field names and JSON pointer prefixes that any rebrand rewriter must skip, plus the paths no tool may write at all. Consumed by shouldRewrite() before a rewrite runs — never used as a content heuristic afterwards.

glob.description: Glob over 'vendor/<tree>/<path>'; '*' never crosses '/', '**/' matches zero or more directories, and '-'/'_' are equivalent on both sides.

expect_match.description: True (default) means the glob must match at least one imported path — an unmatched one is a dead guard and fails denylist-check. False declares a defensive spelling that may match nothing today.

fields.description: Manifest field names rejected regardless of file path.

field_pointers.description: Longer JSON pointer prefixes where attribution may appear, e.g. package.json#author.
